front.title: Semantic Governance Requirements for AI Agent Delegation and Handoff

abstract.t: AI agents increasingly decide and act on behalf of organizations and delegate work to other agents. Identity, authentication, authorization and runtime control mechanisms establish who is acting and what is permitted, but they do not by themselves preserve the organizational meaning of a delegation: the bounded authority, purpose, material context, and the distinction between a recommendation, a decision, an action and its outcome. This document states requirements, derived from the Enterprise Agent Governance Framework (EAGF), that such semantics be preserved across tool calls, delegations and agent-to-agent handoffs. It defines no new protocol.
